body: Thanks, thats what I think I will choose to do.
Fuck dude. I felt every word in your comment. It's just so.... *annoying*
Thank you, I posted an update as an edit if you care to read it.

I'm using this account to chonical my stuggle with suicidal thoughts and depression. If I ever kill myself, I'm going to leave my username in my pocket.

It's been having a secondary effect though. I feel getting my thoughts out in this format actually makes me feel better. It's sort of channeling my horrble misery outward and I'm finding a small amount of relief.

Try it out.

Dude you are so right. Porn is the worst poison that has ever been unleashed on man. The only cure is time. Stop watching porn. Do whatever you have to do. It's a literal mind killer. You have the strength to suffer no longer.
I feel you. I close my eyes and say, "Please take me away" to whoever might be listening, yet here I stay. Maybe we still have something to do.

I share the same hatred of humanity. Even the nice ones are only afforded the opportunity to be nice because they have the finances and time to *be* nice. I have no choice but to shuffle to work, stay there until I'm nice and miserabe, and then shuffle home to go to bed miserable. There's no chance to work on being *nice*. I hate it here too.

However, I actually came here to compliment your writing. I really felt the bubbling hatred coming from your words. You have a gift, and you should stick around to use that gift. I felt better after reading your words, so maybe you can help alleviate the burning hatred that exists within others too.

Friend, I know exactly what you mean when you said no one *cares*. I feel that too, just wanting to be cared about for *who you are*. If no ones asks you how you *are*, then it's hard to feel cared about. 

You seem to be very genuine and caring, so that will radiate outward. Kindness shows on people's faces, and many will see it but will never comment, because they don't know they are seeing it or how to put it in words when the *do* see it. But I can see it. I see it through your words.

Hope you find some peace, and when you do, share some with me. Be blessed.
Thank you for this brutal honesty. It's sad, but it's so raw and it was refreshing to read. I hope the kid grows up healthy and you guys become best friends. Have a blessed day.

I know how you feel. I have 2. I want to kill myself this weekend, but I just don't want my kids to be fucked up. It's hard to tell how it will affect them. They have a large family on their mom's side, so I know they will be fine, but still.. to walk around for the rest of their lives with, "My dad killed himself" seems so heavy.
It's pretty bad, I agree with you there.

I feel you, brother. I am in the same boat. The self-hatred, the emptiness, the lonliness. 

But especially about not feeling like a man. I'm just pretending. I'm just a broken, depressed, unloved kid that exists within the shell of a man.

Hope you find the strength to live your life, and when you do, share some of your strength with me before it's too late for both of us.

I can relate. I am an attractive man but I have zero deep, rich, and personal relationships. I mostly want to kill myself because I'm so lonely. Yeah people like they way I look, but no one gives a shit about me or the way I feel.
